title: Canonical log-entry bytes computation duplicated across verify.rs, tests
description: core/group_log/verify.rs: the bytes hashed for signature verification (hlc_timestamp || article_cid || sorted parent_cids) are inlined in check_signature() and duplicated in test helpers. canonical.rs already provides a pattern for centralizing this. If the canonical format changes, multiple sites need updating. Fix: extract a log_entry_canonical_bytes() function analogous to canonical_article_bytes(); use it in check_signature() and all tests.
